```{r}
options(plotly.cdn = FALSE)

plot_summary_tree <- function(
    folder_name,
    created_range = NULL,
    trait_y,
    trait_z,
    sample_frac  = NULL,
    out_file     = NULL,
    dot_sizes = NULL,
    cluster_paths = NULL,
    file_paths = NULL
) {
  
  #helper functions
  pick_col <- function(df, ...) {
    opts <- c(...)
    hits <- opts[opts %in% names(df)]
    if (length(hits)) hits[1] else NULL
  }

  qlabel <- function(v, low="low", mid="medium", high="high") {
    if (is.null(v) || all(is.na(v))) return(factor(rep(mid, length(v))))
    qs <- stats::quantile(v, probs = c(1/3, 2/3), na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)
    
    qs <- unique(qs)
    if (length(qs) < 2) {
      return(factor(rep(mid, length(v)), levels = c(low, mid, high)))
    }
    cut(v, breaks = c(-Inf, qs[1], qs[2], Inf),
        labels = c(low, mid, high), include.lowest = TRUE)
  }

  read_raw_data <- function(file_paths) {
  data_list <- lapply(file_paths, function(f) read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  out <- dplyr::bind_rows(data_list, .id = "snapshot_id")
  out$snapshot_index <- as.integer(out$snapshot_id)
  out
}

  #read the data
  all_data <- read_raw_data(file_paths)
  if ("created" %in% names(all_data)) {
    all_data$created <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(all_data$created))
  }
  
  
  #read the cluster data and merge it with all_data
  if (!is.null(cluster_paths) && length(cluster_paths) > 0) {
    clist <- lapply(cluster_paths, function(p) {
      tmp <- read.csv(p, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      id_col    <- intersect(names(tmp), c("ID","id"))[1]
      group_col <- intersect(names(tmp), c("Cluster","cluster"))[1]
      tmp <- tmp[, c(id_col, group_col)]
      names(tmp) <- c("ID","Cluster")
      tmp$ID <- as.character(tmp$ID)
      tmp
    })
    clusters_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(clist)
    all_data$ID <- as.character(all_data$ID)
    all_data <- dplyr::left_join(all_data, clusters_df, by = "ID")
  }

  #id check
  needed <- unique(c("ID", "created", trait_y, trait_z))
  missing <- setdiff(needed, names(all_data))
  if (length(missing)) stop("Missing required columns: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))

  all_data$created         <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(all_data$created))
  all_data[[trait_y]]      <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(all_data[[trait_y]]))
  all_data[[trait_z]]      <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(all_data[[trait_z]]))


  #sampling
  set.seed(123)
  keep_ids <- sample(all_data$ID, size = max(1, ceiling(nrow(all_data) * sample_frac)))
  world <- all_data %>% dplyr::filter(ID %in% keep_ids)
  
  #labels
  species_col <- pick_col(world, "species", "ancestor", "parent")
  size_col    <- pick_col(world, "size", "maxEnergy", trait_z)
  speed_col   <- pick_col(world, "speed")
  
  speed_adj <- if (!is.null(speed_col)) {
    spd <- world[[speed_col]]
    qs  <- quantile(spd, probs = c(0, 0.33, 0.66, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
    qs  <- unique(qs)
    if (length(qs) < 4) {
      factor(rep("average", nrow(world)), levels = c("slow","average","fast"))
    } else {
      speed_bins <- cut(
        spd, breaks = qs,
        labels = c("slow","average","fast"),
        include.lowest = TRUE
      )
      factor(speed_bins, levels = c("slow","average","fast"))
    }
  } else factor(rep("unknown speed", nrow(world)))
  
  size_adj <- if (!is.null(size_col)) {
    factor(qlabel(world[[size_col]], "small", "medium", "large"),
           levels = c("small","medium","large"))
  } else factor(rep("unknown size", nrow(world)))
  
  if ("lifeExpectancy" %in% names(world)) {
    exp_life <- world$lifeExpectancy
  } else if ("lifeSpan" %in% names(world)) {
    grp <- if (!is.null(species_col)) world[[species_col]] else factor(1)
    exp_life <- ave(
      world$lifeSpan, grp,
      FUN = function(x) suppressWarnings(stats::quantile(x, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE))
    )
  } else {
    exp_life <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(world))
  }
  
  if ("lifeSpan" %in% names(world)) {
    frac <- suppressWarnings(pmax(0, pmin(1, world$lifeSpan / exp_life)))
    pct  <- ifelse(is.na(frac), NA_integer_, round(frac * 100))
    died_phrase <- ifelse(is.na(frac), "lifespan unknown",
                          ifelse(frac < 0.5,  "died very early",
                                 ifelse(frac < 0.9,  "died early",
                                        ifelse(frac < 0.98, "lived a full life",
                                               "outlived expectations"))))
    died_phrase <- ifelse(is.na(pct), died_phrase,
                          paste0(died_phrase, " at ~", pct, "% of expected lifespan"))
  } else {
    died_phrase <- rep("lifespan unknown", nrow(world))
  }
  
  species_lbl <- if (!is.null(species_col)) paste0(world[[species_col]]) else rep("unknown", nrow(world))
  nkids_txt   <- if ("nkids" %in% names(world)) world$nkids else rep(NA_integer_, nrow(world))
  kids_phrase <- ifelse(is.na(nkids_txt), "kids: n/a",
                        paste0("had ", nkids_txt, ifelse(nkids_txt==1," kid"," kids")))
  born_line <- if ("created" %in% names(world)) paste0("Born at: ", world$created) else ""
  
  hover_text <- paste0(
    "Individual ", world$ID, " (species ", species_lbl, ")<br>",
    "was ", as.character(speed_adj), " and ", as.character(size_adj), "-sized; <br>",
    "it ", kids_phrase, ", and ", died_phrase, ".<br>",
    born_line
  )
  
  #colour
  world$Cluster <- as.integer(world$Cluster)
  clus_ids <- sort(unique(world$Cluster)) #collect all unique cluster ids
  pos_ids  <- clus_ids[clus_ids > 0]
  K        <- length(pos_ids)

  base_cols <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Set2") #creating colour palette
  if (K > length(base_cols)) {
    base_cols <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(base_cols)(K)
  } else {
    base_cols <- base_cols[seq_len(max(K, 0))]
  }

  col_map <- c("0" = "#BDBDBD") #map ids to colours
  if (K > 0) names(base_cols) <- as.character(pos_ids)
  if (K > 0) col_map <- c(col_map, base_cols)

  world$feat_color <- unname(col_map[as.character(world$Cluster)])

  
  #plot
  fig <- plot_ly(
    world,
    x = ~created,
    y = world[[trait_y]],
    z = world[[trait_z]],
    text = hover_text,
    hoverinfo = "text",
    type = "scatter3d",
    mode = "markers",
    marker = list(
      color = world$feat_color,
      size  = dot_sizes,
      opacity = 0.9
    )
  ) %>%
    layout(
      autosize = TRUE,
      scene = list(
        xaxis = list(
          title     = "created",
          range     = c(1, 75000),
          autorange = FALSE   # <- add this
        ),
        yaxis = list(title = trait_y),
        zaxis = list(title = trait_z),
        dragmode = "turntable"
      ),
      margin = list(l = 0, r = 0, b = 0, t = 0)
    ) %>%
    config(responsive = TRUE)
  
  fig <- plotly::partial_bundle(fig, local = TRUE)
  fig <- fig %>% layout(height = 600)

  
  #save file
  dir.create(dirname(out_file), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  tryCatch(
    saveWidget(fig, out_file, selfcontained = TRUE),
    error = function(e) {
      message("Selfcontained save failed: ", e$message,
              " — falling back to non-selfcontained with a local lib dir.")
      saveWidget(fig, out_file, selfcontained = FALSE,
                 libdir = file.path(dirname(out_file), "lib"))
    }
  )
  cat("Saved as", out_file, "\n")
  
  return(fig)
}

```

```{r}
file_paths <- c(
  "/Users/hyoyeon/Desktop/Career/Sony/Lana/2024_12_29_17_15/OEE-data/SummaryIndividuals_35000.csv",
  "/Users/hyoyeon/Desktop/Career/Sony/Lana/2024_12_29_17_15/OEE-data/SummaryIndividuals_40000.csv"
)

TRAIT_Y    <- "pgmDeath"
TRAIT_Z    <- "nkids"
time_range <- c(35000L, 40000L)

fig <- plot_summary_tree(
  folder_name   = params$folder_name,
  created_range = time_range,
  trait_y       = TRAIT_Y,
  trait_z       = TRAIT_Z,
  dot_sizes = 4,
  cluster_paths = c(
    "umap_res/Summary_35000.csv",
    "umap_res/Summary_40000.csv"
  ),
  sample_frac   = 0.01,
  out_file      = file.path(params$out_dir,
                  paste0(params$folder_name, "_summary_", TRAIT_Y, "_", TRAIT_Z, "_tree.html")),
  file_paths    = file_paths     
)

print(fig)
```
